name: McVities Tasties Cashew & Almond Cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Invert Sugar Syrup, Nuts Cashew (0.8%), Almond (0.2%)], Raising Agents [INS 500(ii), INS 503 (ii), INS 450(i)], Iodised Salt, Milk Solids (0.5%), Butter (0.2%), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances and Artificial Flavouring Substances (Cashew, Butter).
